evidence_quote: \[ \text{Depth of Northton's time capsule} = 4 \times \text{Depth of Southton's time capsule} + 12 \]
question_evidence_quote: Northton buries their time capsule 12 feet higher than 4 times the depth of the Southton time capsule.
observed_error: The equation adds 12 feet to four times Southton's depth.
violated_condition: Being 12 feet higher decreases burial depth by 12 feet, so Northton's depth must equal 4 × 15 − 12 feet.
error_description: The response represents “12 feet higher” by adding 12 feet to four times Southton's burial depth. Higher means a smaller depth underground, so the relation requires subtracting 12 feet from that multiplied depth. The subsequent arithmetic correctly evaluates the written expression, but the expression has the wrong direction.
